vectors.name: guest_event
vectors.why: A guest event has no owner and no next key.

vectors.name: guest_with_next
vectors.why: A guest key lasts one request and has no successor.

vectors.name: guest_books
vectors.why: The owner approves the offer once. A guest's pick is one of those slots, and Signet rechecks it's free.

vectors.name: guest_declines
vectors.why: No account is needed to say no.

vectors.name: guest_asks_with_a_note
vectors.why: A note reaches only the owner's page.

vectors.name: open_with_no_owner_approval
vectors.why: An agent can't create a link.

vectors.name: offer_approved_by_the_agent_key
vectors.why: Only the owner approves an offer.

vectors.name: offer_with_slots_the_owner_didnt_approve
vectors.why: The approval binds the exact slots.

vectors.name: guest_picks_a_slot_not_offered
vectors.why: A guest's pick must be an approved slot.

vectors.name: guest_signs_a_confirm
vectors.why: A guest has no owner, so only the requester's side confirms.

vectors.name: guest_note_too_long
vectors.why: A guest's note stops at 280 characters.

vectors.name: guest_key_on_another_request
vectors.why: A guest key counts in one request only.

vectors.name: offer_the_owner_denied
vectors.why: A signed no is never a yes.

vectors.name: offer_naming_another_owner
vectors.why: The owner field must be the signer's.

vectors.name: offer_naming_another_agent
vectors.why: An approval covers one agent.

vectors.name: offer_with_another_operation
vectors.why: A yes to confirming isn't a yes to this offer.

vectors.name: offer_naming_a_request
vectors.why: An offer's approval comes before the request exists.

vectors.name: offer_naming_a_version
vectors.why: A guest request has one offer, at version 1.

vectors.name: offer_naming_a_prev
vectors.why: An offer comes first, so nothing precedes it.

vectors.name: offer_approval_ending_before_the_deadline
vectors.why: An offer's approval ends when the request does, so that's how it names it.

vectors.name: offer_approval_outliving_the_deadline
vectors.why: An approval can't run past the request.

vectors.name: open_with_another_duration_min
vectors.why: The open must say exactly what the owner approved.

vectors.name: open_with_another_purpose
vectors.why: The open must say exactly what the owner approved.

vectors.name: open_with_another_mode
vectors.why: The open must say exactly what the owner approved.

vectors.name: open_with_another_deadline
vectors.why: The open must say exactly what the owner approved.

vectors.name: open_with_another_supersedes
vectors.why: The open must say exactly what the owner approved.

vectors.name: offer_approved_for_another_guest
vectors.why: The approval names one guest key.

vectors.name: first_open_to_one_guest
vectors.why: One approval makes one open, under the nonce it names.

vectors.name: second_open_to_one_guest
vectors.why: One approval, one request: it names one nonce, so a chain alone refuses a second open under another, with no store to trust.

vectors.name: confirm_with_an_approval_for_another_guest
vectors.why: The confirm must carry the approval the offer was made under.

vectors.name: confirm_with_a_longer_meeting_approved
vectors.why: A different approval can't change the deal after the guest answered.

vectors.name: confirm_after_the_approval_expired
vectors.why: An owner's yes ends, even part way through.

vectors.name: guest_confirm_signed_again_with_new_dates
vectors.why: A step carrying an approval copies its dates here too, so R's key can't make copies.

vectors.name: guest_sends_a_received
vectors.why: A guest signs only on a click, so a guest's key has no use for this.

vectors.name: person_text_from_a_guest
vectors.why: A guest has no owner to sign it, so a guest's note goes to the owner's page instead.

vectors.name: requester_counters_after_a_clarify
vectors.why: A guest request has one offer, so the owner's approval always matches it. A new offer is a new link.

vectors.name: requester_counters_after_an_accept
vectors.why: A guest request has one offer, so the owner's approval always matches it. A new offer is a new link.

vectors.name: guest_counters
vectors.why: A guest request has one offer, so the owner's approval always matches it. A new offer is a new link.

vectors.name: clarify_can_end_with_a_decline
vectors.why: With no counter, a clarify ends here and the owner can send a new link.

vectors.name: guest_cancels_a_booking
vectors.why: A guest has no owner, so the guest's click is the authority.

vectors.name: guest_cancel_of_a_booking_with_an_approval
vectors.why: A guest has no approval to carry, so this field can only be a channel.

vectors.name: requesters_owner_cancels_a_booking
vectors.why: R's side still needs its owner.

vectors.name: requesters_agent_cancels_a_booking
vectors.why: A fooled agent can't undo a booking.

vectors.name: final_confirm_beats_a_guests_cancel
vectors.why: R's confirm is the final one on a guest request, and the rule stays the same.

vectors.name: link_outcome
vectors.why: The owner's approval and the guest's signed accept. It says only what a link can show.

vectors.name: link_outcome_labelled_as_an_owners
vectors.why: A link answer can't be presented as an owner's: a guest has no owner to sign.

vectors.name: link_outcome_with_other_terms
vectors.why: The terms must be the offer plus the guest's pick.

vectors.name: link_outcome_with_an_accept_from_another_key
vectors.why: Only the key the offer named can answer it.

vectors.name: link_outcome_tied_anew
vectors.why: The builder for the vectors below makes a good bundle, so each of them differs in one thing.

vectors.name: link_outcome_for_a_slot_not_offered
vectors.why: The pick must be one the owner approved.

vectors.name: link_outcome_the_owner_denied
vectors.why: A signed no is never a yes.

vectors.name: link_outcome_with_another_operation
vectors.why: A yes to confirming isn't a yes to this offer.

vectors.name: link_outcome_naming_another_owner
vectors.why: The owner field must be the signer's.

vectors.name: link_outcome_naming_another_agent
vectors.why: An approval covers one agent.

vectors.name: link_outcome_offered_to_another_guest
vectors.why: The offer names one guest key.

vectors.name: link_outcome_naming_a_request_that_isnt_the_open
vectors.why: The request ID is the open's MessageId.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_open_went_to_another_agent
vectors.why: The open has to be addressed to this guest.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_accept_names_another_request
vectors.why: The accept has to be this request's.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_accept_names_another_prev
vectors.why: The accept has to answer the open.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_accept_is_another_step
vectors.why: It has to be an accept.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_accept_went_to_another_agent
vectors.why: The guest answered R's agent.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_confirm_is_another_step
vectors.why: It has to be a confirm.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_confirm_names_another_request
vectors.why: It has to be this request's.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_confirm_names_another_prev
vectors.why: It has to name the guest's accept.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_confirm_went_to_another_agent
vectors.why: It has to be addressed to the guest.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_open_carries_another_approval
vectors.why: The open must carry the approval in the bundle.

vectors.name: link_outcome_whose_confirm_carries_another_approval
vectors.why: The confirm must carry it too.
